comment:
The clock input is the sharpest fault here. ClockWatcher::tick at src/Traveler.cpp lines 1795 to 1810 counts an external edge only when `externalClock_cv <= 0.f && clock_cv >= 10.f`. A clock that swings 0 to 5V, or one that rests above 0V, produces no edge at all, so the module keeps using the BPM knob and the panel gives no sign of it. The tempo is also taken from the gap between two such edges, so the first edge after patching sets nothing.

Two controls arrive in the opposite state to the one the constructor sets. RUN_BUTTON_PARAM and HERD_BUTTON_PARAM are configured with a default value of 1 (lines 2479 and 2495) and read through SchmittTriggers at lines 2861 and 2878, which see that standing 1 as a rising edge on the first process call and flip isPaused from false to true and isHerding from true to false. The lamps agree with the flipped state, so what a reader sees is a module that comes up paused with herding off.

While a cable is patched into the scale selector jack, processScaleSelect never looks at the four scale select buttons: the branch is an if/else, not a sum. Same shape as a CV jack replacing its knob, but for a bank of buttons.

The pitch outputs are clamped to -5V to +5V, which is 60 semitones either side of note 48; a root note near the top of the 0 to 120 range will therefore flatten against the ceiling.

Index order is not panel order in the wall rows. The Invert row runs SCALE_INVERT_WEST, NORTH, SOUTH, EAST in the enum against a panel printed North, South, East, West, so the tags here were taken from the census positions rather than the enum.

The matrix and the rover and obstacle palette are custom widgets with no ParamWidget per cell, so they have no census positions and get Note lines rather than tags.

Figures in the lines are literals in src/Traveler.cpp: 15 BPM at line 28, the sixfold doubling in processSpeed giving 960, the 16 by 16 field at line 18, the 120 semitone pitch ceiling at line 765, the 48 offset in produceOutput, and the polyphony list of 2 to 16 in PolyphonyMenu.
